manifest.name: KKLT
manifest.author: NightOwlZzz
manifest.description: Unofficial shader family adapting selected lilToon features to Koikatsu on Unity 5.6.2. Partially derived from lilToon by lilxyzw under the MIT License.

Property.Name: LightDirectionOverrideAngles
Property.Tooltip: Angular offset for the ForwardBase toon light direction. RGB 0.5 is neutral. R rotates around X, G around Y and B around Z. A uses the object's axes. Values 0, 0.5 and 1 represent -180, 0 and +180 degrees. The legacy vector remains preserved internally for older materials.

Property.Name: EnvironmentLightInfluence
Property.Tooltip: Controls only Unity realtime SH/environment lighting used by the toon lighting calculation. 0 disables it, 1 preserves the original KKLT/lilToon behavior and values above 1 increase it. It does not affect direct lights, ForwardAdd, reflection probes, matcaps or emission.
